title: Magical Explorer Anime Reveals Second Trailer and Key Visual, Theme Songs by ASCA
content: Magical Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim anime revealed the second trailer and key visual, along with an October 3 premiere. Studio WHITE FOX is handling the animation, with Kazuki Ohashi as the director. The anime was first announced in September 2023.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kotaro Koizumi, Dori Sakurada Guest Star in Doraemon Birthday Special
content: TV Asahi announced on Tuesday that Kotaro Koizumi will guest star in the annual Doraemon Birthday Special on September 6 at 6:56 p.m. JST. Koizumi will play Howard Richie, a 22nd-century billionaire whose billion-yen gem "The Smile of Dorayaki" is stolen.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Confirms First Story Synopsis & Teases Big Fights
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is now hard at work on making its comeback for Season 4 , and it’s teasing some big fights coming in the new episodes with the first story synopsis for the next half of the Culling Game.
author: ComicBook

title: Hunter x Hunter Fans Once Again Celebrate a Major Anniversary
content: Hunter x Hunter’s creator, Yoshihiro Togashi, has long been anime royalty, evne before he introduced the world to the likes of Gon, Killua, Kurapika, and Leorio. Prior to entering this world of hunters, the manga artist brought the story of Yusuke Urameshi to life in Yu Yu Hakusho .
author: ComicBook

title: Red River Anime Reveals New Cast Member, Theme Song Artists
content: The official website for the television anime of Chie Shinohara 's Red River ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ) shōjo manga revealed the new theme song artists and new cast member for the anime's second cours (quarter of a year) on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Announces 3rd Anniversary Season 2 Screening Event
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End will celebrate the third anniversary of its TV anime with a special Season 2 screening event on September 26, 2026. Select episodes from the anime’s 10-episode second season will be shown at nine theaters in Japan.
author: Anime Corner

title: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! Celebrates 20th Anniversary With "REBORN! MUSIC MONTH"
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! TV anime is celebrating its 20th anniversary with a month-long series of music-related projects in September 2026. The campaign, titled “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” is the seventh project announced as part of the anime’s anniversary celebration .
author: Anime Corner

title: Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht Rising Passes 1 Billion Yen in 4 Days, New CM Released
content: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie: Walpurgisnacht Rising has surpassed 1 billion yen at the Japanese box office within its first four days. A new CM trailer featuring previously unseen footage from the film was also released. The movie opened in Japan on August 28 and passed the 1 billion yen mark by August 31.
author: Anime Corner

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 15 Preview
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 15 (Episode 81 overall) preview ahead of its September 2, 2026 premiere. This will be the fourth episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc .
author: Anime Corner

title: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie Reveals New 25th Anniversary Visual, 4K Remaster Screening
content: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie ( Knockin’ on Heaven’s Door ) has revealed a new visual commemorating the 25th anniversary of its theatrical release. A 4K remastered version of the film will also return to theaters in Japan on October 30, 2026.
author: Anime Corner
